# s98plugin

S98 register-log music for retro FM hardware, including the **OPNA
hardware-rhythm drums**.

Extensions: `.s98`

The YM2608 (OPNA) ADPCM rhythm ROM lives in `fmgen`, shared with
[fmpplugin](../fmpplugin/README.md).
